CREATE FUNCTION cdn.DateDiffClarion (@typ smallint, @Data1 int, @Data2 int) RETURNS int AS BEGIN declare @dC datetime declare @d1 datetime declare @d2 datetime
set @dC = convert(datetime,'18001228') set @d1 = dateadd(day,@Data1,@dC) set @d2 = dateadd(day,@Data2,@dC)
if @typ = 1 return( datediff(day, @d1 , @d2 )) else if @typ = 2 return(datediff(month, @d1 , @d2 )) else return(datediff(year, @d1 , @d2 ))
return(0) END
